subject: Vendor onboarding: banking proof & remittance plan for Caldera Logistics
messages:
From: Elena Alvarez <elena.alvarez@caldera-logistics.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: finance@caldera-logistics.com
Date: Thu, 18 Dec 2025 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding: banking proof & remittance plan for Caldera Logistics

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. Attached are the documents you requested to complete Caldera Logistics' vendor setup: a bank letter confirming our account details (Caldera_BANK_LETTER.pdf) and a signed W-9 (Caldera_W9_signed.pdf). We plan to be paid via ACH; wire is available as a fallback.

A few notes to help match payments to our invoices:
- Please include the originating PO number in the remittance reference field (we submit PO as REF12345 format).
- For ACH, send test micro-deposit on account ending in 4321 so our AP team can confirm.
- Our preferred invoice email is finance@caldera-logistics.com.

Do you need any additional verification (e.g., bank letter notarization or CFO attestation)? I can also accept a DocuSign if that speeds things up.

Next steps from our side: we'll sign any DocuSign and confirm micro-deposit schedule once you confirm the test window.

Cheers,
Elena Alvarez
Vendor Ops | Caldera Logistics
elena.alvarez@caldera-logistics.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments:
- Caldera_BANK_LETTER.pdf (pdf)
- Caldera_W9_signed.pdf (pdf)

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Elena Alvarez <elena.alvarez@caldera-logistics.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Dec 2025 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: banking proof & remittance plan for Caldera Logistics

Thanks Elena — received the bank letter and W-9. I'm adding Priyom from PayOps to confirm the routing for the ACH test and to confirm what we need to map the PO on our side.

@Priyom — can you confirm these items?
- Do we require notarized bank letters for new vendors, or is the provided bank letter + W-9 sufficient?
- Micro-deposit workflow: once you initiate the test deposit, please tell Caldera to confirm amounts and which timestamp window to expect (we'll need them to reply back to finance@caldera-logistics.com).
- Invoice PO mapping: we need the exact PO field name/value to accept inbound invoice parsing. Elena suggested REF12345 format — will that map to our PO_reference field?

Elena — attaching the PO template we use for reference. Priyom will follow up on whether we need any additional legal docs.

Date: Thu, 18 Dec 2025 13:29:00 -08:00
Subject: Caldera onboarding — follow-up & PO template attached

Hi Elena / Caldera Finance team,

Appreciate the docs — they look good at first pass. A couple of items we'll action from Redwood's side:
- Priyom will schedule the ACH micro-deposit for Mon 2025-12-22 (target window: 10:00–14:00 PT). Please confirm once you've seen it and provide the two deposit amounts.
- We'll set up Caldera as an active vendor in our AP system with the attached PO_template.csv that maps to our invoice ingestion. For mapping accuracy, please confirm that you will populate the PO field using the "REF" prefix (example: REF12345).
- If you prefer wires for the first remittance, reply with the required wire instructions and our SOW team will flag the initial payment as wire.

Action items for you:
1) Confirm preferred remittance text (PO only / PO + invoice number).
2) If DocuSign is easiest, sign the DocuSign link below — we need a business representative on file.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/pack/3xz8-caldera-po
PO template (attached): PO_template.csv

Thanks — I'll loop in PayOps (Priyom) to kick the micro-deposit.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments:
- PO_template.csv (csv)

From: Elena Alvarez <elena.alvarez@caldera-logistics.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: banking proof & remittance plan for Caldera Logistics

Hi Marissa / Jonas / Priyom,

Thanks — we can confirm the following:
- We'll populate the PO field as REF#### (REF12345 example) on every invoice, so PO mapping should be straightforward.
- We'll sign the DocuSign today and send back the confirmation (expect it by EOD).
- Caldera's AP will watch for the micro-deposit on Mon 2025-12-22 and confirm amounts to finance@caldera-logistics.com once received.

Wire instructions for the rare fallback (attached as part of the bank letter second page). If you need a notarized bank letter, inform me and I can request one from our bank — otherwise the attached bank letter + signed W-9 is our standard vendor proof.
